name: 머리 자세 추정 분석
description: 얼굴 조작을 나타내는 3D 머리 자세 궤적의 불일치를 감지합니다.
useCase: Exposing 딥페이크s through unnatural head pose transitions and geometric 불일치
mechanism: Estimates 3D head orientation (pitch, yaw, roll) 에 걸친 frames and 분석 the trajectory smoothness. Deepfake 얼굴 교환s often produce head poses that are inconsistent 사이의 the source and target face, creating detectable discontinuities in the pose trajectory.
source: Yang, X. et al. (2019) - Exposing Deep Fakes Using Inconsistent Head Poses, ICASSP
algorithm: 3D Head Pose Estimation (PnP) + Trajectory Smoothness Analysis + Source-Target Consistency
parameters: Landmarks: 68-point model, Pose estimation: EPnP algorithm, Smoothness: Savitzky-Golay filter
